scenarios.detail: FastAPI connects to the running MinIO container
HTTP PUT goes to localhost:9000; exact version HEAD validated by API
Authorized URL returns the expected bytes
Same GET URL succeeds again before its 60-second TTL

Two finalized uploads have distinct real MinIO version IDs
Unfinalized replay creates a physical version but catalog still downloads approved v2
DeleteObject creates a marker; current download is blocked by the application
Application removes the exact recorded marker
Server-side version COPY creates a new current version with the original bytes
Storage accepted the bytes; catalog rejects mismatched size (transport cap not claimed)
MinIO allows localhost:8000 direct PUT preflight
Account audit records confirmation, delete and restoration events
Identical URL that succeeded twice now returns HTTP 403 after TTL
